items.title: 2.11 Do dimensions mein inelastic takrao (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.11 with Fig. 2.17 (PDF 46-48).

blocks.text: Bare paimane ke (macroscopic) takrao aam taur par inelastic hote hain aur kinetic energy baqi nahi rakhte. Perfectly inelastic takrao woh hai jis mein takrati cheezein takrao ke baad chipak kar ek mass ban jati hain. Masses m1 aur m2 ke do sakht ajsam lein jo do-dimensional xy-plane mein velocities v1i aur v2i se chalte hain; pehla jism x-axis ke saath chalta hai jabke doosra x-axis se zawiya theta banati simt mein, aur dono asal (origin) par takrate hain (Fig. 2.17). Takrao ke baad ajsam chipak jate hain, mila hua mass M = m1 + m2, jo x-axis se zawiya phi par velocity vf se chalta hai. v2i ko rectangular components v2i sin theta aur v2i cos theta mein, aur vf ko vf sin phi aur vf cos phi mein torein.

blocks.alt: Axes x aur y. Jism m1 x-axis ke saath velocity v1i se asal ki taraf chalta hai; jism m2 x-axis se zawiya theta wali lakeer par velocity v2i se asal ki taraf. Asal par takra kar mila hua jism velocity vf se x-axis se zawiya phi par oopar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Do dimensions mein perfectly inelastic takrao (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: x- aur y-simton mein momentum
blocks.text: x: m1 v1i cos theta1 + m2 v2i cos theta2 = M vf cos phi ... (2.39). y: m1 v1i sin theta1 + m2 v2i sin theta2 = M vf sin phi ... (2.40). (Print aam shakal pehle jism ke liye theta1 aur doosre ke liye theta2 ke saath likhta hai; pehla jism x-axis ke saath ho to theta1 = 0.)
Aakhri velocity aur zawiye ka hal

Aakhri velocity vf ki miqdar: (2.39) aur (2.40) ko muraba kar ke jama karne se vf = sqrt( [(m1 v1i cos theta1 + m2 v2i cos theta2)/M]^2 + [(m1 v1i sin theta1 + m2 v2i sin theta2)/M]^2 ) ... (2.41). Aakhri zawiya phi: (2.40) ko (2.39) par taqseem karne se phi = tan^-1 [ (m1 v1i sin theta1 + m2 v2i sin theta2) / (m1 v1i cos theta1 + m2 v2i cos theta2) ] ... (2.42). Yahan phi inelastic takrao ke baad chipke do ajsam ki mushtarka velocity ki x-axis se simt hai. m1, m2, M, theta1, theta2, phi, v1i, v2i aur vf ki qeematein (2.39) aur (2.40) mein rakh kar is soorat mein momentum ke baqa ka qanoon sabit kiya ja sakta hai.

Chunke takrao inelastic hai, takrate system ki kinetic energy baqi nahi rehti; nuqsan yun nikalta hai. Takrao se pehle kul ibtidai kinetic energy (KE)i = (1/2) m1 v1i^2 + (1/2) m2 v2i^2 ... (2.43); chunke kinetic energy scalar hai, formula ki velocities ko components mein torne ki zaroorat nahi. Takrao ke baad, jab cheezein chipak jayein, kul aakhri kinetic energy (KE)f = (1/2) M vf^2 ... (2.44), jahan vf (2.41) se aakhri velocity ki miqdar hai. Energy ka nuqsan: chunke takrao inelastic hai, kinetic energy ka nuqsan hota hai, delta KE = (KE)i - (KE)f, jo garmi, awaz ya bigaar jaisi doosri shakalon mein badalta hai. m1, m2, M, v1i^2, v2i^2 aur vf^2 ko (2.43) aur (2.44) mein istemal kar ke inelastic takrao se pehle aur baad ki kinetic energy aur zaya energy ki miqdar tay ki ja sakti hai.

items: Jab karate ka waar eenton ka dher torta hai: cheezein takrao ke baad wapas nahi uchhaltin; waar ki kuch energy eentein jazb karti hain, jo garmi, awaz aur unhen torne ki force ban jati hai, to energy haath ko wapas uchhalne ke bajaye eentein torne mein jati hai. Agar waar bilkul amoodi na ho aur kuch ufqi harkat shamil ho to momentum ki muntaqili aur nateeje ki forces ke ufqi aur amoodi dono components honge.

Car ke hadse mein takrao ufqi aur amoodi dono simton mein inelastic hai: gariyan takra kar takrao ki energy jazb karti hain, kuchalti aur bigarti hain; yeh energy jazb hona gariyon ko sust karta aur wapas uchhalne se rokta hai, aur zyada tar kinetic energy garmi, awaz aur gariyon ke nuqsan mein zaya hoti hai.

Gend aur bat inelastic rawayya dikhate hain: jab bat gend ko marta hai to kuch kinetic energy gend ke bigarne se zaya hoti hai, aur energy garmi aur awaz mein bhi badalti hai; bat sakht hone ke bawajood energy mukammal taur par muntaqil nahi karta aur khud kuch energy jazb karta hai; gend takrao par dabti hai, jo mazeed nuqsan deta hai, to poori ibtidai kinetic energy baqi nahi rehti aur takrao majmooi taur par inelastic hai.

blocks.prompt: x ke saath 3 m s^-1 se chalta 2 kg ka jism x se 90 degrees par 3 m s^-1 se chalte 1 kg ke jism se chipak jata hai. Mushtarka velocity aur zaya energy nikalein.
blocks.explanation: x: 2 x 3 + 0 = 3 vf cos phi = 6; y: 0 + 1 x 3 = 3 vf sin phi = 3; to vf = sqrt(6^2 + 3^2)/3 = sqrt(45)/3 = 2.24 m s^-1 aur phi = tan^-1 (3/6) = 26.6 degrees. (KE)i = (1/2)(2)(9) + (1/2)(1)(9) = 13.5 J; (KE)f = (1/2)(3)(5) = 7.5 J; 6 J garmi, awaz aur bigaar mein zaya.

items: Do ajsam asal par chipakte hain: momentum x (2.39) aur y (2.40) mein baqi; vf murabon ke majmooe ke jazr taqseem M se (2.41), phi nisbat se (2.42); pehle (2.43) aur baad (2.44) ki KE ka farq garmi, awaz aur bigaar ka nuqsan hai. Misalein: karate waar, car hadsa, bat aur gend.
